%c[255,170,220,255]Reading the percentages%c[default]
Equipment indicators account for the current condition of the outfit, helmet and active belt artefacts: damaged equipment contributes less. They are equipment ratings, not a guaranteed percentage reduction of every incoming hit.

%c[255,120,210,120]Ballistic armor%c[default]
The general Armor row combines only the outfit's torso armor and active belt artefacts. Ballistic head protection is calculated separately, applies to head hits and is shown in the helmet tooltip. It is deliberately excluded from the Armor row so protection for different body regions does not produce an inflated and confusing percentage.

%c[255,255,190,90]Other protections%c[default]
Radiation, chemical, electrical, thermal, psi and other general protection indicators still combine the applicable values from the outfit, helmet and active belt artefacts. Temporary boosters are also included where the mechanic supports them.
